summary: This is a routine Form 6-K by Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. reporting Q2 2026 financial results and announcing a conference call. The filing includes a press release and earnings presentation with IFRS financial statements, incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No special-situation event is present—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. The filing merely disseminates routine quarterly financial information and operational updates. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation and is classified as 'None.'
